newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS - Evans Deakins says has better Q1.
newsitem.headline: RTRS - Evans Deakins says has better Q1.

text.p: Engineering group Evans Deakins Industries Ltd said on Thursday earnings for the first quarter to September 30 were stronger than in the previous corresponding quarter.

"Financial year 1997 has commenced an a satisfactory basis and the profit for the first quarter is in excess of that of the previous year," Evans Deakins' chairman Ronald Paul said at the company's annual meeting in Brisbane.
"We look forward to a successful 1997," he said.
Paul said however the company expected domestic and overseas markets to be difficult in the medium term.
Evans Deakins posted a net profit of A$14.11 million in the year to June 30, 1996, up from A$12.34 million a year earlier.
The company successfully completed a A$192 million takeover of Sydney-based engineering company Clyde Industries Ltd in August this year.

Paul said the Clyde takeover would leave the group with a turnover in excess of A$700 million and a wide range of business activities spread across all mainland states of Australia as well as five overseas plants.
"Evans Deakin has spent A$49 million on capital expenditure in the past eight years and your board is committed to keeping your company at the forefront of technology," Paul said.
At 12.40 p.m. (0140 GMT), Evans Deakins shares were one cent higher at A$3.41.
